name: Enticing Negolash
summary: Along Stranglethorn Vale's shore, a marked lifeboat offers a way to lure Negolash. Ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine lie on the wreck.

sections.title: A Tempting Offering
sections.body: The abandoned lifeboat bears the faded words Smotts' Revenge. While hunting Negolash, arrange ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine on the wreck to draw him out.

faq.answer: The Ruined Lifeboat is an abandoned, broken boat marked with the faded words Smotts' Revenge. You can arrange food and drink there to lure Negolash.

faq.q: What provisions are required for the offering?
faq.answer: The offering requires ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine, stacked on the wreck.

faq.q: When does this task become available?
aliases: when can i do enticing negolash
faq.answer: You can prepare the offering only while hunting Negolash.
